_doc: Example Hyperliquid DRY-RUN config with a config-driven dry-run replay. Copy this file, rename it, and fill in your values. Same as hyperliquid_strategy_config_example.json plus the dry_run_replay block below.
_doc_hip3: To trade TradFi/HIP-3 pairs (XYZ-AAPL, XYZ-GOLD, PARA-BTCD, etc.), keep hip3_dexes below. Remove it if you only trade crypto.
_doc_position_coordination: Stops several bots from stacking on the same pair. mode: off | compat (share only same-side, reconcile leverage via leverage_policy lowest/highest/keep/block) | strict (never share a pair held by a sibling). scope: wallet (default — only bots on THIS wallet coordinate; bots on distinct wallets of the same exchange stay independent) | exchange (coordinate across every wallet on the exchange). Wallet identity is auto-detected from the credentials; set account to override with a label. Siblings are auto-discovered from this config's directory.
_doc_dry_run_replay: Optional, DRY-RUN ONLY. Auto-seeds this bot's history on startup via a dry-run replay (simulate as if it had run since start_date). Runs once (idempotent — a seeded DB is skipped). automatic_launch + start_date are REQUIRED; end_date defaults to 'today'; resolution is 1m | 5m | 15m (default 1m, finer = slower but more faithful); reset_db false (default) = keep existing trades and stop the replay at the first real trade, true = wipe the dry DB first. Dates are DD/MM/YYYY. A machine-wide coordinator caps concurrent replays to (cores - 2 - hyperopt cores).
